title: Predict: Swift WTF Moments
hints: Arrays are values; emoji families are single characters; `&+` wraps.
`.some(nil)` is not equal to `nil` at the outer level — but its unwrapped value is.
jsBridge: Swift's surprises are different from JS's WTFs (`[] + {}`). They come from strictness: grapheme counting, value copies, overflow traps and optional printing. Each is a deliberate trade-off rather than an accident.
